Kill those PMCs so that my dogs could grab the loot without any issues. There are three bases in total: the big fortified construction site building on Customs, the former EMERCOM medical unit in Priozersky forest, and the Azure Coast health resort. Clear the places out and let me know when it's done.}} ==Requirements== * Must be level 42 to start this quest. ==Objectives== * Eliminate 12 PMC operatives at any Scav base on [[Customs]],[[Woods]], or [[Shoreline]] ==Rewards== * +69,999 [[EXP]] * 1× [[Armband (RFARMY)]] * 1× [[Armband (USEC)]] * 1× [[Rys-T bulletproof helmet (Black)]] * 2× [[Rys-T face shield]] * 1× [[6B43 Zabralo-Sh body armor (EMR)]] * Unlocks purchase of [[9x39mm SP-6 gs]] at [[Prapor]] LL4 {{quote|All clear now? Good job, warrior. I'll send my guys to get the stuff then.}} ==Guide== Only the enemy PMCs have to be in the marked areas for the kills to count towards the objective.
